tiktok.caption_rule: lead with the pain and promise one practical fix

instagram.caption_rule: make the post easy to save and share with a team

packages.hook: You do not need another AI tool. You need one weekly growth workflow.
script: Show the messy stack: research notes, draft docs, reply tabs, and reports.
Name the real problem: the tools are not connected by a weekly operating rhythm.
Show the fix: pain radar on Monday, content drafts Tuesday, replies Wednesday, report Friday.
Close with a review gate: do not publish until a human checks the draft.
packages.caption: A simple weekly AI growth workflow beats a bigger tool stack.

packages.hook: Small agencies lose hours because client reporting is rebuilt from scratch.
script: Open with the monthly reporting scramble.
Show the three required layers: pain signals, content output, and learning signals.
Turn the layers into a repeatable report template.
End with a saveable checklist for the next client review.
packages.caption: Save this reporting structure before your next client growth review.
